messages:
Alex P: Heads up — received a PO for QuantumWare via Azure Marketplace but it fails our ingestion. Portal returns vendor alias mismatch and ProcureBot rejected the XML. Can someone help unblock?
ProcureBot: PO 9345 rejected: error_code=vendor_alias_mismatch; validation: <vendorIdentification>QCW-LLC</vendorIdentification> vs expected 'QuantumWare Inc' — see portal rejection screenshot link: https://azmarketplace.example/snap/9345 :warning:
Ben D: Can you paste the raw PO XML? need to check vendor identifiers and the marketplace mapping. Also, does QuantumWare have an alternate legal entity in their marketplace profile?
Alex P: Pasting snippet we got from the portal: ```xml
<PurchaseOrder id="9345">
  <Vendor>QCW-LLC</Vendor>
  <VendorTaxId>78-1234567</VendorTaxId>
  <BillingEntity>QuantumWare Inc</BillingEntity>
</PurchaseOrder>
```
Sara L: pinging QuantumWare AM now (cc @Ben D). I asked them to confirm the vendor alias used for marketplace POs and whether they recently migrated entity names. :phone:
Priya (Legal): Quick check — do we have outstanding redlines on the Master Marketplace Agreement for QuantumWare? If legal names differ, finance won't accept mapping until the contract entity is confirmed.
Ben D: Finance confirmed they require exact vendor name match to our ledger. Workaround is manual aliasing but needs finance ops approval + audit note. I can open a ticket with Azure marketplace support for vendor alias sync — will include PO 9345, vendor tax id, and portal trace.
Alex P: If QuantumWare confirms QCW-LLC is an alternate DBA that's fine, but we need a signed attestation from them to keep with the PO for audit. Sara — can you ask them for a short confirmation email?
Sara L: On it. Asked AM to push attestation and confirm whether they changed their seller ID (S-ID) in Azure. They said a recent account consolidation may have introduced the alias.
Priya (Legal): If they provide attestation, Legal can approve a one-off mapping and update the MSA record. But if there are indemnity changes in the new entity, we escalate. Also flagging: watch for warranty/indemnity language mismatch.
Ben D: Created support case with Azure: CASE-2026-9876; assigned to Marketplace Integrations. I'll paste the case link and update here when they respond. Action items: 1) Sara get attestation email from QuantumWare; 2) Ben push Azure case and request vendor alias sync; 3) Alex hold off on manual acceptance until finance okays aliasing + legal attestation.
Alex P: Thanks team. Adding a screenshot of the portal error and our internal PO ingest log for trace: https://internal.example/logs/ingest/9345 :thumbsup:
ProcureBot: Auto-note: awaiting manual intervention — PO 9345 suspended.
Sara L: AM replied — they attached signed attestation PDF and confirmed the seller S-IDs: old=S-12345 new=S-98765. Sending PDF to Legal & Finance now. :email:
Ben D: Azure responded: queued vendor sync, ETA ~48hrs. Marking this thread for escalation if not resolved by 72hrs.
Priya (Legal): Received attestation. Reviewing now — will call out any legal entity mismatch. If clean, I'll sign off and request Finance to apply alias mapping.
Alex P: Great. I'll keep this thread updated. If anyone gets blocked, mention @Ben D and I'll escalate to partnerships leadership. Thanks! :raised_hands:
